title: Target shoppers are visiting more often as the holidays gear up
summary:
Target's bid to get shoppers back is showing results as it gears up for the holidays, recent data show.
Placer.ai found that Target stores saw a 7.2% increase in chain-wide visits for the third quarter, including a 5.9% increase in same-store visits.
In addition, roughly half of shoppers visited Target twice a month or more, and nearly one in eleven shoppers visited five times or more.
Other data from Advan Research found a 4.7% year-over-year increase in foot traffic at Target in the third quarter, compared with 1.7% at Walmart.
